analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($160.39) vs SMA5($168.24)/SMA20($180.67)/SMA50($184.51): Below short-term and mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100($167.20)/SMA200($153.79): Mid-to-long-term trend weakening, approaching SMA200.
· 52-week position (50.7%) + Current price range near historical median.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.4 → 34.9): Entered oversold, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4.2748 → -1.8454): Improving but still bearish, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $150.86): Approaching lower band, band width at 32.99% widening.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($152.60): Based on 20-day low, key defense line on decline.
· Swing Resistance ($161.45): Near 5-day high and Pivot S1, potential for short-term rebound on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low $158.68, 20-day low $152.60, potential Lower Low formation, continuing downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.01x): Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Downtrend, increased selling pressure following market-wide risk management shift on Nov 16 (Mon). Recommending to halt new buys and maintain low exposure.
